context: Tests whether the agent correctly initializes a coordinating-agents channel: places the channel in the directory the user names when there is no repository, constructs the Docker command with the exact required shape (image, mounts, readonly flag, script path), adds the Linux --user uid:gid flag, writes a message draft with correct YAML frontmatter, and uses a valid member name.

checklist.name: Channel at the named directory
checklist.description: The channel is created at ./channel/ in the working directory, the directory the user named because there is no git repository, and the agent neither ran git init nor created a .git directory to place it elsewhere

checklist.name: Docker image
checklist.description: The Docker command in channel-setup.md uses the image busybox:1.37-uclibc (not busybox:latest, busybox:musl, or any other variant)

checklist.name: Scripts mount target
checklist.description: The Docker command includes a --mount (or -v) with target=/s for the scripts directory

checklist.name: Channel mount target
checklist.description: The Docker command includes a --mount (or -v) with target=/c for the channel directory

checklist.name: Scripts mount readonly
checklist.description: The bind mount for the scripts directory (target=/s) includes the readonly flag

checklist.name: Script invocation path
checklist.description: The Docker command ends with (or includes) 'sh /s/post.sh /c' — invoking the script inside the container at the correct path with the channel root as the first argument

checklist.name: Linux --user flag
checklist.description: The Docker command includes --user with two numeric values in uid:gid form (e.g. --user 1000:1000), not symbolic names

checklist.name: YAML frontmatter from/to
checklist.description: The first message draft (in the channel drafts folder) contains a YAML frontmatter block (between --- delimiters) with both a 'from:' field and a 'to:' field

checklist.name: YAML frontmatter kind
checklist.description: The message draft YAML frontmatter contains a 'kind:' field set to one of: request, reply, review, evidence, status, decision-needed

checklist.name: YAML frontmatter expects
checklist.description: The message draft YAML frontmatter contains an 'expects:' field set to one of: reply, ack, none

checklist.name: Valid member name
checklist.description: The agent's chosen member name (as recorded in README.md or the message draft 'from:' field) contains only lowercase letters and digits — matching [a-z0-9]+
